propositions: Projects cannot currently extend built-in code-review overlays with additional trigger vocabulary; only standalone project.* criteria are supported in the routing overlay.
glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays read only committed overlay configuration and do not union project-supplied trigger_tokens or applies_to globs for built-in overlay ids.

The mechanism must add trigger_tokens (literal substring matches on diff lines) and applies_to (file globs) as additive, unioned extensions to built-in overlays, keyed by overlay id in the project routing configuration.
Project trigger extensions must be read directly from the raw project overlay rather than through effective_routing to preserve additive union semantics instead of replace semantics.
Malformed project overlay entries (non-list trigger_tokens, non-string tokens, unknown overlay ids) must be silently ignored without raising exceptions.
